status: Source-grounded reconsideration only; no new implementation or training.

cards.title: Perceiver IO: A General Architecture for Structured Inputs & Outputs
cards.code_evidence: PerceiverEncoder, lines 354 onward: input-to-learned-latent cross-attention plus repeated latent self-attention; BasicDecoder, lines 472 onward: output-query cross-attention.
cards.source_status: Primary PDF section 3 and actual author-organization source inspected; branch URL not immutable.
cards.pipeline: Encode evidence into temporary learned latent array -> repeated latent processing -> decode through task-specific output query.
cards.proposed_transfer: Use the already computed, typed OSRAM head reads as evidence and a Local-derived decoder query; temporary latent array exists within one utterance only. This decoder query must not access OSRAM memory again.
cards.retention_rule: Keep encode/process/decode and distinct latent workspace; reducing it to Local cross-attention pooling does not qualify.
cards.reason: Shape-compatible without a spatial grid, but only 9/17/25 active input items means the original huge-input scalability motivation is absent. Added latent computation needs a task-specific justification.
cards.non_claim: Learned latents are not reconstructed missing modalities and have no guaranteed semantic interpretation. No MOSI performance evidence.

cards.title: Compositional Attention Networks for Machine Reasoning
cards.code_evidence: control() lines 122–169, read() lines 188 onward, write() lines 251 onward; __call__ composes these into a recurrent reasoning cell.
cards.source_status: Primary PDF method and actual author source inspected; branch URL not immutable.
cards.pipeline: Question-conditioned recurrent control -> attend over visual knowledge -> update separate working-memory state; repeat for a reasoning chain.
cards.reason: The present Local is one vector, not question-word sequence. Its control attention degenerates on a single token. Inventing words by reshaping channels is not a valid transfer.
cards.code_nuance: The source exposes controlContinuous as an ablation, which bypasses word attention; a local-conditioned iterative readout inspired by it could be a separate design, not faithful full MAC.
cards.non_claim: Temporary working-memory states are different from OSRAM persistent memory; they must never silently add another temporal cache.

cards.title: Universal Transformers
cards.code_evidence: universal_transformer_layer() lines 220–230 separates ACT from fixed-step recurrence; get_ut_layer() lines 263–269 provides the basic shared transformation.
cards.source_status: Primary PDF and actual Google/Tensor2Tensor code inspected; branch URL not immutable.
cards.pipeline: Apply shared self-attention and transition repeatedly in depth, with step/position signals; adaptive per-position halting is optional.
cards.reason: Fixed-depth recurrence can operate on typed evidence without a temporal cache, but a generic tied Transformer is weakly motivated for current-history relations. Retaining ACT would add halting/ponder choices outside this first screen.
cards.retention_rule: No ACT/ponder loss, no fabricated positional distances between heads, no claim that stacking attention is itself a new substantial mechanism.
cards.non_claim: No evidence that current OSRAM has a reasoning-depth deficit.

cards.title: Learning by Abstraction: The Neural State Machine
cards.source_status: Primary PDF sections 3.1–3.4 inspected. Original-author runnable source not verified; third-party NSM repositories are not treated as official.
cards.pipeline: Construct semantic probabilistic scene graph with concept vocabulary -> translate question to instructions -> traverse graph states under these instructions -> answer.
cards.reason: The evidence interface has neither object graph nor semantic concept vocabulary or question instructions. Rebranding head slots as objects/concepts would invent unobserved structure.
cards.non_claim: The full method is substantial, but this does not make it a compatible OSRAM readout.

cards.title: Neural Production Systems: Learning Rule-Governed Visual Dynamics
cards.source_status: Primary PDF section 3.1 steps 2–4 and section 3.2 inspected. Official runnable repository not verified in this pass; the paper checklist alone does not establish code availability.
cards.pipeline: Bind a primary slot to a rule and one contextual slot using hard stochastic selection -> apply rule-specific MLP -> sparse slot-state update; use sequential or parallel rule application.
cards.reason: Complete sparse rule execution is more than a scalar gate, but meaningful state/rule factorization is not established for OSRAM read vectors. Straight-through stochastic routing would also add optimization variables, so it is not an immediate candidate.
cards.non_claim: No learned rule is automatically a sentiment rule; no latent slot is automatically an object or a missing modality.
